headings.title: Creation of department and director appointment and duties
headings.reviewNote: Creates the department of natural resources, provides for director appointment by the governor, and specifies administrative duties.

headings.title: Appointment of staff directors and department personnel
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to appoint board staff directors with board approval and appoint other department and board employees under chapter 36.

headings.title: Transfer of commissions and boards to department
headings.reviewNote: Transfers air conservation, clean water, and state park entities to the department, transfers environmental improvement and water resources entities to those commissions, and restricts clean water commission member income conflicts.

headings.title: Transfer of soil and water districts commission
headings.reviewNote: Transfers the powers, duties, and functions of the state soil and water districts commission to the department.

headings.title: Transfer of state geologist and oil and gas council
headings.reviewNote: Transfers state geologist and oil and gas council functions to the department and directs appointment of state geologist.

headings.title: Transfer of land reclamation commission and personnel
headings.reviewNote: Transfers land reclamation commission to the department and reserves commission authority over personnel selection and positions.

headings.title: Transfer of drinking water and waste functions
headings.reviewNote: Transfers division of health functions concerning safe drinking water and solid waste management to the department.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsections for 640.010 establishing the department, director duties, personnel appointments, and board/commission transfers (dual effective dates: 8-28-13 H.B. 28; 10-11-13 H.B. 650 after veto override).

headings.title: Authority to require applicant and volunteer fingerprints
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to require fingerprint submissions for employment or volunteer applications.

headings.title: Submission of fingerprints for criminal background checks
headings.reviewNote: If fingerprint submissions are required, directs the department to require applicants to submit fingerprints to the highway patrol for state and federal criminal history checks.

headings.title: Processing of records and departmental record access
headings.reviewNote: Governs transmission of fingerprints to state and federal repositories and guarantees departmental access to discovered criminal records.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.011 covering permissive fingerprint requirements, conditional highway patrol background checks, and departmental record access.

headings.title: Citation of authority and regulatory impact requirement
headings.reviewNote: Mandates citation of specific statutory authority and preparation of a regulatory impact report for environmental condition rules.

headings.title: Required contents of regulatory impact report
headings.reviewNote: Specifies thirteen required components of the regulatory impact report including economic, environmental, and risk evaluations.

headings.title: Use of peer-reviewed data and explanations
headings.reviewNote: Requires peer-reviewed data for regulatory impact reports or written explanations and source citations when unavailable.

headings.title: Publication of notice and public comment period
headings.reviewNote: Requires newspaper and website publication of report notice and provides at least sixty days for public comment.

headings.title: Filing report with joint administrative rules committee
headings.reviewNote: Directs filing of the regulatory impact report with the joint committee on administrative rules concurrently with proposed rules.

headings.title: Void status of rule for failure to report
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a proposed rule is void if the department, board, or commission fails to conduct the required regulatory impact report without filing a timely written explanation of unavailable peer-reviewed data.

headings.title: Immediate action exception for rule adoption
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes rule adoption without a prior impact report when immediate action is necessary to protect human health, public welfare, or the environment, with written justification and 180-day completion.

headings.title: Exemption for federal rules adopted without variance
headings.reviewNote: Exempts adoption of Environmental Protection Agency or other applicable federal agency rules without variance from this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsections for 640.015 specifying environmental regulatory impact report contents, peer-reviewed data rules, publication, committee filing, immediate-action exception, and federal-rule exemption.

headings.title: Limitation on permit conditions and restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits the department from imposing permit restrictions not authorized by statute or regulation.

headings.title: Applicant review of draft permit before comment
headings.reviewNote: Establishes applicant review rights for draft permits before public notice and remedies for uncorrected drafting errors.

headings.title: Statement of basis required for permit denial
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to clearly state the basis for denying a permit under listed environmental chapters and commissions.

headings.title: Restriction on permit revocation or modification
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits revoking or changing an approved permit or action for one year without written permission from the permittee unless immediate action is necessary to protect human health, public welfare, or the environment.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 640.016 governing permit restriction limits, applicant pre-comment review, stated basis for permit denial, and one-year revocation limits.

headings.title: Petition for unified permit schedule
headings.reviewNote: Permits applicants needing multiple environmental permits to petition the director for a coordinated permit schedule.

headings.title: Development of unified permitting process
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to develop and implement a process to coordinate multiple environmental permit applications.

headings.title: Departmental initiation for classes of activities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to initiate unified permit processes for classes of similar regulated activities.

headings.title: Identification of required permits and opt-out right
headings.reviewNote: Provides for early permit identification, allows applicants to opt out of unified schedules, and requires online posting.

headings.title: Establishment of permit order and independent review
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice of permit order, restricts schedule modifications without applicant consent through the public hearing date, and preserves independent review on each application's merits.

headings.title: Consolidation of public hearings near facility
headings.reviewNote: Directs coordination to consolidate all permit public meetings and hearings into a single local hearing.

headings.title: Waiver of procedural timing requirements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to waive procedural timing requirements under listed environmental chapters provided public comment periods are not shortened and substantive legal compliance is not impaired.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and administrative procedure compliance
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to promulgate rules under chapter 536 and includes nonseverability provisions rendering post-August 28, 2008 rulemaking invalid if legislative review powers are held unconstitutional.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsections for 640.017 providing for unified environmental permitting schedules, opt-out rights, consolidated hearings, procedural waivers, and rulemaking (dual effective dates: 8-28-13 H.B. 28; 10-11-13 H.B. 650 after veto override).

headings.title: Mandatory permit issuance upon statutory deadline expiration
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to issue a permit upon request if statutory deadlines expire after complete information is provided.

headings.title: Sealed engineering submittals and departmental review
headings.reviewNote: Governs submission of sealed engineering plans and requires departmental review by a professional engineer or intern.

headings.title: Supervisory engineer determinations on submittal comments
headings.reviewNote: Establishes departmental supervisory engineers and procedures for applicants to request determinations on engineering comments.

headings.title: Limitation on professional engineer requirement
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that plans or other submittals for general or site-specific permits need not be prepared by a registered professional engineer unless otherwise required under state or federal law.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 640.018 addressing permit issuance after statutory deadline expiration, sealed engineering submittals, supervisory engineer determinations, and engineer-preparation limits (cross-referenced to nonseverability clause § 640.099).

headings.title: Annual list of external enforcement documents
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department, by December 1, 2013, and annually thereafter, to submit to the joint committee on administrative rules a list and copies of non-statutory, non-promulgated external documents (excluding permits) used to implement enforcement actions or penalties.

headings.title: Required contents and disclosure statement on documents
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required identifying information and mandatory disclosure statements on departmental documents for external dissemination.

headings.title: Methods for submitting document lists and URLs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to provide required document lists and materials via physical copies or direct electronic URLs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.026 covering annual reporting of external enforcement documents to JCAR, mandatory disclosure statements, and delivery methods (dual effective dates: 8-28-13 H.B. 28; 10-11-13 H.B. 650 after veto override).

headings.title: Cleanup and disposal of controlled substance hazards
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to assist in cleaning up and disposing of hazardous substances from controlled substance manufacturing.

headings.title: Cost recovery from responsible manufacturing parties
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the department to recover cleanup and disposal costs from parties responsible for controlled substance manufacturing.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for cleanup operations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to promulgate rules necessary for implementing controlled substance cleanup and disposal.

headings.title: Administrative procedure compliance for rules
headings.reviewNote: Conditions the validity of promulgated cleanup rules on compliance with chapter 536 procedures.

headings.title: Creation of controlled substances cleanup fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Controlled Substances Cleanup Fund in the state treasury, provides that moneys shall not lapse notwithstanding section 33.080, and credits interest to the fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 640.040 establishing permissive cleanup assistance for controlled substance laboratories, cost recovery, rulemaking, and the Controlled Substances Cleanup Fund.

headings.title: Creation and authorized uses of revolving fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the revolving services fund to receive publication sales proceeds and support printing, equipment, and services.

headings.title: Sale of publications and deposit of income
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to produce and sell maps, plats, and publications and deposit charges in the revolving services fund.

headings.title: Exemption of fund balance from general revenue transfer
headings.reviewNote: Exempts unencumbered revolving fund balances up to one million dollars from transferring to general revenue under section 33.080.

headings.title: Quarterly financial reports to legislative committees
headings.reviewNote: Requires quarterly reports of revolving services fund income and expenditures to legislative budget and appropriations committees.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 640.065 creating the revolving services fund, publication sales, $1 million fiscal-year balance exemption, and quarterly legislative reporting (dual effective dates: 8-28-13 H.B. 28; 10-11-13 H.B. 650 after veto override).

headings.title: Identification of alternative funds for constitutional refunds
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to identify an equal amount from other appropriated departmental funds if an Article X, Section 18 refund from listed water funds would violate federal Clean Water Act or Safe Drinking Water Act requirements.

headings.title: Transfer of alternative funds to general revenue
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commissioner of administration to transfer the identified alternative funds to state general revenue for any refund occurring after August 28, 2004.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.078 governing identification and transfer of alternative departmental funds for Article X, Section 18 refunds after August 28, 2004.

headings.title: E. coli water quality standard for beaches
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the geometric mean E. coli bacteriological standard for designated swimming beaches in state parks.

headings.title: Advisory signage upon standard exceedance
headings.reviewNote: Mandates posting of advisory warning signs when state park swimming beaches exceed E. coli bacteria standards.

headings.title: Authority to close beach for health risks
headings.reviewNote: Reserves departmental authority to close state park swimming beaches in the event of documented public health hazards.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.080 setting state park swim beach E. coli standards, advisory signage, and closure authority (dual effective dates: 7-12-13 H.B. 28; 9-11-13 H.B. 650 after veto override; Revisor's Note flags constitutional/statutory ambiguity on overridden emergency clause effective dates).

headings.title: Implementation impact report requirement and submission
headings.reviewNote: Requires preparation, legislative submission, and online posting of implementation impact reports for federal air and water plans.

headings.title: Criteria and evaluations required in report
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates thirteen specific economic, technical, environmental, and public health criteria required in the impact report.

headings.title: Required stakeholder meetings for air and water plans
headings.reviewNote: Directs stakeholder meetings with designated industry and public interest groups for air and water implementation plans.

headings.title: Legislative committee hearings on proposed plans
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the joint committee on government accountability to hold public hearings on submitted impact reports and plans.

headings.title: Protection of cooperative and municipal utility jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section does not grant the department or public service commission jurisdiction over electric cooperatives or municipal utilities.

headings.title: Preservation of section 643.640 provisions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that nothing in this section alters, limits, or supersedes the provisions of section 643.640.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 640.090 governing implementation impact reports for federal air and water plans, stakeholder meetings, committee hearings, and utility jurisdiction (effective 10-16-15 after veto override; original-roll citation notes: '7412' for 42 U.S.C. 7411 in sub. 1 and '12541' for 33 U.S.C. 1251 in sub. 3).

headings.title: Commission rulemaking authority for safe drinking water
headings.reviewNote: Requires the safe drinking water commission to promulgate rules necessary for implementing, administering, and enforcing sections 640.100 to 640.140 and the federal Safe Drinking Water Act.

headings.title: Notice, hearing, and administrative procedure requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days' prior notice and public hearings for drinking water rules and establishes chapter 536 compliance conditions.

headings.title: Certification of operators, testers, and testing fees
headings.reviewNote: Mandates rules for certifying operators, backflow assembly testers, and labs, and sets maximum drinking water testing fees.

headings.title: Inventory of public water supplies and surveys
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to maintain an inventory of public water supplies, conduct sanitary surveys, and make records public.

headings.title: Annual customer service connection fee schedule
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes annual customer service connection fees based on water system size and meter dimensions to fund drinking water primacy.

headings.title: Collection and transmission of customer connection fees
headings.reviewNote: Governs collection of state connection fees by public water suppliers, quarterly transmission, and administrative fee retention.

headings.title: Fee suspension upon withdrawal of federal primacy
headings.reviewNote: Mandates suspension of state drinking water connection fees if federal administration primacy delegation is withdrawn.

headings.title: Comprehensive fee review and legislative oversight
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes comprehensive fee review, commission approval by two-thirds vote, legislative concurrent resolution disapproval within sixty calendar days, and sets an August 28, 2030 expiration for fee-revision authority while keeping the existing fee structure in place.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsections for 640.100 covering safe drinking water rulemaking, certifications, surveys, connection fee schedule table, collection, federal primacy suspension, and fee review authority expiring August 28, 2030.

headings.title: Establishment and composition of safe drinking water commission
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the nine-member Safe Drinking Water Commission and specifies member appointment and qualification requirements.

headings.title: Commission officers, meetings, quorum, and terms
headings.reviewNote: Governs officer elections, meeting frequencies, quorum requirements, four-year terms, and gubernatorial vacancy appointments.

headings.title: Reimbursement for travel and actual expenses
headings.reviewNote: Provides for reimbursement of travel and other actual and necessary expenses incurred by commission members in performing their duties.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.105 establishing the nine-member Safe Drinking Water Commission, organization, meetings, terms, and expense reimbursement.

headings.title: Establishment of drinking water revolving fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Drinking Water Revolving Fund as a separate subfund for purposes authorized under the federal Safe Drinking Water Act and the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009.

headings.title: Project selection criteria and disadvantaged community subsidies
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to establish project selection criteria and loan subsidy procedures for disadvantaged communities.

headings.title: Annual intended use plan and public comment
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to formulate an annual intended use plan for revolving fund monies following public comment.

headings.title: Fund allocation for systems under ten thousand
headings.reviewNote: Mandates reserving at least thirty-five percent of revolving fund assistance for small water systems serving under ten thousand people.

headings.title: Technical assistance and training for small systems
headings.reviewNote: Allocates two percent of federal capitalization grants for technical assistance and training to public water systems under ten thousand people.

headings.title: Additional financial assistance and subsidy mechanisms
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state financial assistance including loan subsidies, principal forgiveness, and grants under federal drinking water law.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 640.107 covering the Drinking Water Revolving Fund, project criteria, intended use plans, small-system allocation table (35% minimum), technical assistance, and financial subsidies.

headings.title: Filing of plans and required operating permit
headings.reviewNote: Requires public water suppliers to file system plans and obtain a written operating permit of approval before dispensing water.

headings.title: Compliance of system construction and alterations
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that construction, extension, or alteration of public water systems comply with safe drinking water commission rules.

headings.title: Continuing operating authority and capacity requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires applicants to show a permanent continuing operating authority, and requires systems commencing operation after October 1, 1999, to maintain managerial, technical, and financial capacity.

headings.title: Capacity review and revocation for noncompliant systems
headings.reviewNote: Provides for capacity evaluations and potential permit revocation for noncompliant water systems subject to administrative orders.

headings.title: Administrative appeals and judicial review procedures
headings.reviewNote: Establishes administrative appeals through the administrative hearing commission and judicial review in the court of appeals.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 640.115 governing public water system plan filings and operating permits, construction compliance, continuing operating authority capacity, revocation, and AHC/court of appeals review.

headings.title: Exemption for charitable organization water systems
headings.reviewNote: Exempts qualifying charitable or benevolent organization water systems (serving under 100 persons on average at least 60 days/year and no school or day-care) from well construction rules except multifamily well rules under sections 256.600 to 256.640, absent groundwater or public health threats.

headings.title: Remedial measures for repeated contamination violations
headings.reviewNote: Mandates alternative water supplies, source elimination, or viral disinfection upon repeated coliform or acute contaminant violations.

headings.title: Grandfathering of wells constructed before August 2011
headings.reviewNote: Exempts qualifying wells constructed prior to August 28, 2011, from compelled replacement or alteration unless determined to threaten groundwater or public health or to contain subsection 2 contaminant levels.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.116 providing well construction exemptions, contamination remediation options, and pre-August 28, 2011 well protections for qualifying charitable or benevolent organization water systems.

headings.title: Mandatory drinking water contaminant testing
headings.reviewNote: Requires testing of public water systems for state and federal regulated contaminants and other hazardous substances.

headings.title: Frequency of contaminant testing and emergency orders
headings.reviewNote: Establishes contaminant testing frequencies and authorizes emergency departmental orders for increased testing.

headings.title: Sampling protocols for lead and plumbing contaminants
headings.reviewNote: Regulates first-draw tap sampling for lead and plumbing contaminants and requires property owner permission for private sampling.

headings.title: Authority to grant variances and exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to grant variances and exemptions from state primary drinking water regulations.

headings.title: Inspection of water systems and search warrants
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes entry and inspection of public water supplies and establishes search warrant procedures upon denied access.

headings.title: Annual public water system census and reports
headings.reviewNote: Directs annual publication of a water system census and public notification of drinking water quality reports and trends.

headings.title: Requirement for lead-free materials and joint exception
headings.reviewNote: Requires lead-free materials in public water systems and connected building plumbing while permitting lead to repair lead joints connecting cast iron pipes in use prior to August 28, 1989.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsections for 640.120 governing drinking water contaminant testing, sampling protocols, variances, inspections and warrants, annual census/reports, and lead-free material requirements.

headings.title: Reporting test results to department and customers
headings.reviewNote: Requires public water systems to report water test results to the department and to consumers under safe drinking water rules.

headings.title: Record retention requirements and public noncompliance notice
headings.reviewNote: Mandates retention of operational and analytical records and requires public notification of water system violations or variances.

headings.title: Furnishing information on demand during investigations
headings.reviewNote: Obligates water suppliers to provide operational and water quality information to the department upon demand during investigations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.125 concerning test result reporting, record retention, public noncompliance notices, and investigatory information demands.

headings.title: Emergency orders to abate health dangers
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the department to issue immediate emergency orders without prior notice or hearing to protect drinking water supplies.

headings.title: Injunctive enforcement actions by attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the attorney general to initiate injunctive proceedings to enforce drinking water laws, regulations, and departmental orders.

headings.title: Administrative compliance orders for statutory violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to issue administrative compliance orders upon determining that a public water system is in violation.

headings.title: Civil monetary penalties and settlement procedures
headings.reviewNote: Establishes daily civil penalty limits for drinking water violations and prescribes written settlement negotiation procedures.

headings.title: Appeals of emergency orders to circuit court
headings.reviewNote: Provides for judicial appeal of emergency drinking water orders to the circuit court within thirty days and expedited hearings.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 640.130 establishing emergency orders, attorney general injunctive actions, administrative compliance orders, civil penalties and settlement offers, and circuit court appeals.

headings.title: Administrative penalties and informal conciliation prerequisites
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative penalties for drinking water violations following required efforts at conference, conciliation, and persuasion.

headings.title: Maximum penalty tiers and assessment factors
headings.reviewNote: Specifies tiered maximum daily and cumulative administrative penalties based on water system population and statutory factors.

headings.title: Penalty order contents, appeals, and delinquency surcharges
headings.reviewNote: Regulates penalty order recitals, appeal procedures to the commission, payment deadlines, and delinquent payment surcharges.

headings.title: Limitations on penalty increases and assessment deadlines
headings.reviewNote: Bars penalty increases caused by departmental delay and imposes a two-year statute of limitations on assessing administrative penalties.

headings.title: Judicial review of final penalty orders
headings.reviewNote: Provides for judicial review of final administrative penalty orders under chapter 536 following exhaustion of administrative remedies.

headings.title: Election between administrative and civil penalty remedies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the state to elect between pursuing administrative penalties or requesting civil penalty litigation in circuit court.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 640.131 governing drinking water administrative penalties, population tiers, order contents and appeals, two-year assessment limit, judicial review, and remedy election.

headings.title: Advance notice requirements for water fluoridation modifications
headings.reviewNote: Mandates ninety days' advance notice to state agencies and customers prior to voting on fluoridation modifications and requires returning fluoridation to previous levels until proper notice is given if violated.

headings.title: Responsibility for investor-owned water system notices
headings.reviewNote: Places compliance responsibility for fluoridation modification notices on the entity initiating discussions in investor-owned systems.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.136 requiring 90-day agency and customer notification before voting on water fluoridation modifications and assigning notice duty for investor-owned systems (dual effective dates: 8-28-16 H.B. 1717; 10-14-16 H.B. 1713 after veto override).

headings.title: Source water assessment boundaries and contaminant identification
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to delineate source water protection areas, identify contaminant origins, and publish assessment results.

headings.title: Voluntary source water protection petition program
headings.reviewNote: Permits the department to establish a petition program supporting voluntary partnerships for community source water protection.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.137 governing source water area assessments, public reporting, and permissive voluntary source water protection partnerships.

headings.title: Cybersecurity risk mitigation plan requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires each community water system, within twelve months of August 28, 2020, to create a plan establishing policies, procedures, risk assessments, and controls to identify and mitigate cyber risk.

headings.title: Exemption for systems without internet-connected controls
headings.reviewNote: Exempts community water systems that do not operate internet-connected control systems from cybersecurity requirements.

headings.title: Exemptions for specified jurisdictions and utilities
headings.reviewNote: Excludes state parks, large municipalities, certain charter counties, and major regulated utilities from cybersecurity planning.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.142 establishing cybersecurity risk mitigation plan mandates for community water systems and defining exempt systems and jurisdictions.

headings.title: Valve inspection, repair, and mapping program
headings.reviewNote: Requires community water systems to inspect valves every ten years, schedule repair or replacement of broken valves, and map shut-off valves within five years of August 28, 2020, using GIS or an alternative physical mapping system.

headings.title: Hydrant testing, repair, flushing, and mapping
headings.reviewNote: Mandates scheduled hydrant testing, repair or replacement, hydrant and dead-end main flushing plans, six-year record retention, and mapping within five years of August 28, 2020, using GIS or an alternative physical mapping system.

headings.title: Exemptions for specified public entities and utilities
headings.reviewNote: Excludes state parks, larger cities, specified charter counties, and large public service commission utilities from inspection rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.144 establishing valve and hydrant inspection, repair, flushing, and mapping mandates and listing exempt public entities and utilities.

headings.title: Certification report of compliance upon request
headings.reviewNote: Requires community water systems to submit certification reports verifying compliance with testing, inspections, and cyber policies upon request.

headings.title: Exemptions for specified public entities and utilities
headings.reviewNote: Exempts state parks, large cities, certain charter counties, and major regulated utilities from compliance reporting requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.145 providing for departmental compliance certification reports upon request and listing exempt public entities and utilities.

headings.title: Definitions for home energy auditor certification
headings.reviewNote: Defines applicant, department (department of economic development), qualified home energy audit, and qualified home energy auditor.

headings.title: Development of certification criteria and requirements
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department of economic development to develop certification criteria and requirements, and authorizes it to establish periodic requirements to maintain certification.

headings.title: Written notice of approved certification
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to issue written notifications to applicants successfully meeting energy auditor certification standards.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.153 defining home energy audit terms, establishing certification criteria under the department of economic development, and requiring written notice of certification.

headings.title: Confidentiality of voluntarily reported energy information
headings.reviewNote: Deems voluntarily reported energy information confidential and exempt from public disclosure upon written request for a mutually agreed period when traceable to a private firm, partnership, public corporation, or individual.

headings.title: Scope and definition of energy information
headings.reviewNote: Defines energy information to encompass reserves, exploration, production, distribution, pricing, capital investments, and related data.

headings.title: Penalties and summary dismissal for unlawful disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Makes unauthorized disclosure of confidential energy data a class A misdemeanor and grounds for immediate employment dismissal.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.155 protecting confidentiality of voluntarily reported energy information, defining energy information, and penalizing unlawful disclosure.

headings.title: Creation of energy futures fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Energy Futures Fund in the state treasury, designates the treasurer as custodian, and exempts balances from reversion.

headings.title: Authorized uses of fund for energy programs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes expenditures from the fund upon appropriation for energy efficiency projects, resource analyses, and program administration.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.160 establishing the Energy Futures Fund and authorizing department of economic development expenditures upon appropriation (source note records statutory reference change from § 640.150 to § 620.035 and §§ 640.153–640.160 per 2018 revision).

headings.title: Creation of natural resources protection fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Natural Resources Protection Fund with dedicated air and water pollution permit fee subaccounts.

headings.title: Reversion rules and interest retention for fund
headings.reviewNote: Requires biennial reversion of subaccount balances exceeding prior biennium collections from July 1, 1991, before June 30, 2027, ends reversion beginning July 1, 2027, and credits interest to appropriate subaccounts.

headings.title: Sales tax transfers for air pollution control
headings.reviewNote: Directs annual transfers of five percent of electric utility sales tax revenues to the air pollution control subaccount starting in 2027.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.220 establishing the Natural Resources Protection Fund, 2027 reversion transition rules, and annual electric power distribution sales and use tax transfers starting July 1, 2027.

headings.title: Allocation of damages for chemical emergency preparedness
headings.reviewNote: Allocates ten percent of natural resource damages, up to one hundred thousand dollars annually, to chemical emergency preparedness.

headings.title: Deposit of remaining damages for resource restoration
headings.reviewNote: Directs deposit of remaining natural resource damages into the protection fund for resource rehabilitation and assessment costs.

headings.title: Coordinated fund use and federal damage restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes pooling with other funds such as the hazardous waste fund (note: text cites subdivisions (1)-(3) of subsection 1, though those subdivisions appear in subsection 2) and restricts 42 U.S.C. 9607(f) recoveries to restoring, replacing, or acquiring equivalent natural resources.

headings.title: Transfers to conservation commission fund for damages
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes reimbursement transfers to the conservation commission fund for fish, wildlife, and forestry damage evaluations.

headings.title: Biennial reversion limit and transfer of excess
headings.reviewNote: Exempts damage subaccount balances up to two million dollars from biennial reversion while allowing excess transfers by appropriation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 640.235 governing allocation of natural resource damages to chemical emergency preparedness, restoration, pooled and federal 42 U.S.C. 9607(f) uses, conservation commission fund transfers, and $2 million non-reversion cap.

headings.title: Title of Missouri water resource law
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the statutory title of sections 640.400 to 640.435 as the Missouri Water Resource Law.

headings.title: Departmental duties to maintain and protect resources
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to inventory, monitor, and protect the quality and quantity of state water resources for beneficial uses.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.400 citing the Missouri Water Resource Law and establishing departmental duties to maintain, inventory, monitor, and protect state water resources.

headings.title: Definitions for water exportation regulation
headings.reviewNote: Defines applicant, beneficial uses, commission, pipeline facility, water exportation permit, and related terms.

headings.title: Permit requirement for water exportation and exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits out-of-state water exportation without a departmental permit while exempting bottled water and border-area uses.

headings.title: Prohibition on export pipelines and reporting duties
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits water export pipelines beyond thirty miles of state borders and mandates annual reporting of withdrawal volumes.

headings.title: Director review criteria and required conditions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies seven mandatory review criteria including resource availability, in-state priority, and county commission notice.

headings.title: Permit application procedures, timelines, and renewals
headings.reviewNote: Governs application review schedules, public comment, commission hearings, three-fourths majority voting, and permit renewal rules.

headings.title: Permit duration and annual reporting requirements
headings.reviewNote: Sets a three-year permit term and requires annual reporting of water withdrawal volumes and end-use destinations on the website.

headings.title: Scope of application and partial approval authority
headings.reviewNote: Allows permit applications covering multiple water withdrawal points and authorizes partial approval by the director or commission.

headings.title: Requirement of in-state agent for service
headings.reviewNote: Requires water exportation permit applicants to designate an in-state agent for service of process and legal notices.

headings.title: Major water user requests for permit reevaluation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes procedures for major water users to request reevaluation of export permits that negatively affect beneficial uses.

headings.title: Preservation of private rights and injunctive remedies
headings.reviewNote: Preserves constitutional, statutory, and common law water rights claims, denies permit defense to infringement claims, and authorizes injunctive actions by harmed persons.

headings.title: Attorney general enforcement actions and commissioner forfeiture
headings.reviewNote: Directs attorney general enforcement actions and prescribes forfeiture of office for commission members violating this section.

headings.title: Mandatory permit reevaluation during drought emergencies
headings.reviewNote: Mandates reevaluation of existing water exportation permits during a governor-declared drought emergency under section 44.100 (citing subsection 3 criteria in text) and authorizes modification or revocation subject to commission approval or denial.

headings.title: Severability of pipeline export provisions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that invalidity of pipeline export restrictions in subsection 3 does not affect the remainder of the section.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 13 subsections for 640.406 establishing water exportation permitting, pipeline restrictions, review timelines, reevaluations, private and AG enforcement, drought reevaluations, and severability (source notes: 'Subsection 3' appears in original rolls for subsection 4 references in subs. 5 and 9; word 'and' appears in original rolls in sub. 9; sub. 12 retains reference to subsection 3).

headings.title: Development of state water resources plan
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to develop, maintain, and update the long-range comprehensive State Water Resources Plan.

headings.title: Procedures for public participation in planning
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to establish procedures ensuring public participation in drafting and revising the water plan.

headings.title: Legislative reporting and approval by concurrent resolution
headings.reviewNote: Mandates preliminary reports to the general assembly and submission of the state water plan for approval by concurrent resolution.

headings.title: Reporting requirements and intergovernmental cooperation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to require user reports and enter cooperative contracts with governmental or private entities.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 640.415 covering development of the State Water Resources Plan, public participation, legislative reporting and concurrent-resolution review, and permissive reporting/cooperation powers.

headings.title: Authority to establish special water protection areas
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to establish special water quality protection areas where contaminant concentrations exceed federal, state, or chapter 644 standards and threaten public health or the environment.

headings.title: Consultation, boundary determination, and designation orders
headings.reviewNote: Requires interagency consultation, boundary determinations, public hearings, and detailed geographic designation orders.

headings.title: Local public hearings and community notice
headings.reviewNote: Mandates local public hearings and notice to affected municipalities, counties, and news media prior to area designation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.418 governing permissive designation of special water quality protection areas, interagency consultation, boundary orders, and local public hearings/notices.

headings.title: Establishment of interagency water task force
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to establish an interagency task force comprising state agriculture, conservation, health, and university representatives.

headings.title: Meeting schedule and lead agency designation
headings.reviewNote: Requires semiannual task force meetings and designates the department as lead agency for surface and groundwater protection.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.430 establishing the interagency water task force, semiannual meetings, and departmental lead-agency status.

headings.title: Judicial review of final departmental orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes any person aggrieved by a final departmental water order to seek judicial review under chapter 536.

headings.title: Preservation of statutory duties under related chapters
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that the Missouri Water Resource Law does not supersede regulatory duties established under chapters 640 and 644.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.435 providing chapter 536 judicial review of final departmental orders and preserving duties under chapters 640 and 644.

headings.title: Grant application procedures and evaluation criteria
headings.reviewNote: Requires applicants to apply first to the primary financial source before seeking a departmental grant, directs rulemaking generally conforming to federal agencies, and lists seven evaluation criteria.

headings.title: Commitment from primary financial source required
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits final grant approval until the applicant provides proof of financial commitment from its primary funding agency.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.615 establishing primary-source application prerequisites, grant rulemaking criteria, and primary financial commitment requirements.

headings.title: Landowner rights to private water and ground source systems
headings.reviewNote: Retains Missouri landowners' rights to own and use private water and ground source systems (unless prohibited by city ordinance and subject to departmental rules) without being forced to purchase community water.

headings.title: Landowner rights to rainwater collection systems
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees the right of Missouri landowners to install and maintain rainwater harvesting systems on their property.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.648 retaining landowner rights to private water and ground source systems (subject to city ordinance prohibitions and DNR rules) and rainwater collection systems.

headings.title: Application for energy conservation project loans
headings.reviewNote: Governs applications for energy conservation project financing, requiring technical assistance reports and permitting cooperative projects.

headings.title: Payback score ranking and loan conditions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes payback score selection criteria, payback duration limits, energy cost recovery requirements, and governing body approvals.

headings.title: Application processing deadlines and default approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires departmental action within ninety days of application closing and deems unacted applications approved as submitted.

headings.title: Education department review of public school projects
headings.reviewNote: Requires DESE review and certification of public elementary and secondary school energy projects within specified deadlines.

headings.title: Health department review of hospital projects
headings.reviewNote: Directs submission of proposed hospital energy projects to DHSS for certification of compliance with health requirements.

headings.title: Higher education board review of facility projects
headings.reviewNote: Mandates review and certification by the Coordinating Board for Higher Education for public higher education energy projects.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 640.653 governing energy conservation loan applications, payback score rankings, 90-day default approvals, and interagency project certifications.

headings.title: Loan repayment terms and interest rates
headings.reviewNote: Directs loan repayment with interest based on funding source terms and schedules determined by the department.

headings.title: Annual budget allocation for loan payments
headings.reviewNote: Requires loan recipients to budget annually sufficient funds to satisfy required energy loan repayment obligations.

headings.title: Payment from energy savings and tax limitation
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits additional tax levies for loan repayment, requires funding from energy savings, and permits loan restructuring if savings fall short.

headings.title: Deduction from state aid upon school default
headings.reviewNote: Directs deduction of delinquent energy loan payments from state school apportionments for deposit into the set-aside fund.

headings.title: Deduction from sales tax upon local government default
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to notify the director of revenue to deduct local government loan payments overdue by sixty days from local sales tax distributions for immediate deposit in the energy set-aside fund.

headings.title: Remittance and deposit into energy loan fund
headings.reviewNote: Requires loan recipients to remit payments to the department for immediate deposit into the energy set-aside loan fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 640.660 establishing energy loan repayments from cost savings, tax levy prohibitions, 60-day default deductions from school aid and local sales taxes, and fund deposits.

headings.title: Establishment of energy loan account and retention
headings.reviewNote: Requires borrowers to maintain a dedicated energy loan account on their books and retain all accounting records for three years.

headings.title: Maintenance of internal records for audits
headings.reviewNote: Obligates borrowers to maintain comprehensive internal records for project auditing and verification of energy expenditures.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.663 requiring a dedicated energy conservation loan account with three-year record retention and auditable internal project records.

headings.title: Establishment of energy set-aside program fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs the state treasurer to establish the Energy Set-aside Program Fund administered by the department for conservation loans.

headings.title: Sources of deposits into program fund
headings.reviewNote: Specifies revenue sources for the fund including legislative appropriations, federal monies, loan repayments, and earned interest.

headings.title: Revolving loan authority and administrative expenses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes reissuing loan repayments for new projects and allows expenditure of earned fees and interest for program administration.

headings.title: Disbursement of moneys by commissioner of administration
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commissioner of administration to disburse moneys from the fund at times authorized by the department.

headings.title: Exemption from general revenue fund transfer
headings.reviewNote: Exempts funds in the energy set-aside program fund from section 33.080 unexpended-fund transfers to general revenue except as otherwise provided in sections 640.651 to 640.686.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 640.665 establishing the Energy Set-aside Program Fund, deposit sources, revolving loan authority, disbursements, and section 33.080 exemption.

headings.title: Restricted use of loan funds and default remedies
headings.reviewNote: Restricts loan expenditures to approved project purposes and directs legal recovery actions upon default or unauthorized fund use.

headings.title: Collection remedies against defaulting public borrowers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to initiate state aid and sales tax deductions against public entities defaulting on loan payments for sixty days.

headings.title: Collection actions against other defaulting borrowers
headings.reviewNote: Permits legal collection actions with attorney general approval against entities not subject to statutory tax intercept procedures.

headings.title: Departmental authority to audit loans and computations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to conduct audits of loan fund expenditures and repayment calculations under the energy program.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 640.672 restricting loan fund use, directing recovery upon improper use or default, authorizing collection actions, and permitting discretionary audits.

headings.title: Administration, sector allocation rules, and interest rates
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to establish administrative procedures and equitable sector allocation rules, and authorizes it to establish interest rates and sector-specific rules.

headings.title: Legislative committee approval requirement for rules
headings.reviewNote: Conditions the effectiveness of energy loan rules on review and approval by the joint committee on administrative rules.

headings.title: Submission of proposed rules to committee
headings.reviewNote: Requires concurrent submission of proposed administrative rules to the joint committee and authorizes committee hearings.

headings.title: Final rulemaking timeline and committee review
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a thirty-day review period for final orders of rulemaking prior to filing with the secretary of state.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for committee rule suspension
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates four specific statutory grounds authorizing the joint committee to vote to suspend an order of rulemaking.

headings.title: Prohibition on filing disapproved rules
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits the filing or publication of any proposed administrative rule or portion thereof disapproved by the committee.

headings.title: Legislative ratification of committee rule disapprovals
headings.reviewNote: Requires joint committee findings reports to both legislative chambers and legislative ratification of rule disapprovals by resolution within thirty legislative days.

headings.title: Legislative revocation or suspension of adopted rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the general assembly to revoke or suspend adopted rules by bill or constitutional concurrent resolution.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsections for 640.674 governing energy loan administrative procedures, permissive interest rates, and joint committee/general assembly rule review, suspension, and revocation.

headings.title: Authority to secure financing and establish partnerships
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to obtain outside financial assistance and establish public-private partnerships for energy conservation projects.

headings.title: Administrative and monitoring agreements and fee authority
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the director to negotiate administrative or project-monitoring agreements and assess fees to cover departmental costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.676 authorizing public-private energy conservation partnerships, outside financing, administrative/monitoring agreements, and permissive cost-recovery fees.

headings.title: Authority to prescribe bond forms and covenants
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department and authority to specify bond terms, forms, and covenants to secure repayment for energy projects.

headings.title: Performance of bond duties and fee collections
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the department and authority to execute statutory duties and collect adequate rates and service charges for bonded projects.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.686 authorizing the department and authority to prescribe revenue bond forms and covenants and collect project rates and charges.

headings.title: Rulemaking and permitting authority for class I facilities
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to promulgate rules regulating class I facilities and authorizes site-specific monitoring wells for class IA lagoons in hydrologically sensitive areas.

headings.title: Mandatory buffer distances for animal feeding operations
headings.reviewNote: Establishes tiered buffer distances between concentrated animal feeding operations and public buildings or occupied residences.

headings.title: Exemption for existing facilities and signed agreements
headings.reviewNote: Exempts concentrated animal feeding operations existing as of June 25, 1996, and operations with written agreements signed by all affected property owners within the buffer distance.

headings.title: Buffer distance adjustments and county governing body review
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes departmental recommendations for reduced buffer distances based on site factors, effective unless rejected by majority vote of the county governing body at its next meeting.

headings.title: Preservation of local government regulatory authority
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory buffer distance regulations do not restrict local governmental regulatory controls.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 640.710 establishing class I CAFO rulemaking, tiered buffer distances, June 25, 1996 and written-agreement exemptions, county governing body review, and local controls.

headings.title: Advance notice requirements for operating permit applications
headings.reviewNote: Mandates certified mail notification to the department, county governing body, and adjoining property owners within three times the buffer distance for new or expanded class IA/IB/IC facilities, proof of notice, and a thirty-day public comment period.

headings.title: Compliance prerequisite for operating permit issuance
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuing CAFO operating permits unless the applicant demonstrates full compliance with state animal feeding operation laws.

headings.title: Application review timeline and construction prohibition
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a forty-five day departmental permit review timeline and forbids commencing facility construction prior to permit issuance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 640.715 requiring advance certified-mail notice, thirty-day public comment, statutory compliance, 45-day permit review, and pre-permit construction prohibition.

headings.title: Weekly and daily inspection schedules and records
headings.reviewNote: Mandates weekly visual inspections of flush systems, daily inspections during high lagoon levels, and three-year record retention.

headings.title: Mandatory automatic shutoff systems for pipe stoppage
headings.reviewNote: Requires electronic or mechanical shutoff systems for pipe stoppage on new flush-system permits and for pipe stoppage or backflow on existing facilities as of July 1, 1997.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.725 establishing flush-system inspection schedules, high-level lagoon monitoring, three-year records, and automatic shutoff requirements (effective 8-28-13 H.B. 28/H.B. 542; 10-11-13 H.B. 650 after veto override).

headings.title: Containment structure requirements for flush waste systems
headings.reviewNote: Mandates emergency containment structures or earthen dams holding twenty-four hours of flush capacity for high-risk animal waste systems.

headings.title: Construction commencement deadline for containment dams
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a ninety-day construction commencement deadline following June 25, 1996, for mandatory waste containment dams.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.730 requiring 24-hour failsafe containment structures or earthen dams for qualifying flush systems and commencement within 90 days of June 25, 1996 (source note: word 'and' does not appear in original rolls in sub. 1).

headings.title: Annual lagoon fee for class IA facilities
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a ten-cent per animal unit annual fee on class IA flush operations for ten years to fund lagoon remediation.

headings.title: Administration and purposes of lagoon closure fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to administer the fund for carrying out sections 640.700 to 640.755 relating to closure of class IA, IB, IC, and II concentrated animal feeding operation wastewater lagoons.

headings.title: Eligibility conditions for government-controlled properties
headings.reviewNote: Restricts lagoon closure fund expenditures to government-controlled properties posing health, environmental, or groundwater threats after reasonable and prudent efforts to remediate or sell.

headings.title: Closure expenditure limits and technical remediation standards
headings.reviewNote: Caps closure expenses at one hundred thousand dollars per lagoon and prescribes nutrient management, dewatering, and berm grading standards.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 640.745 establishing the ten-year class IA lagoon closure fee, departmental fund administration, government-property eligibility, and $100,000 per-lagoon closure cap.

headings.title: Administrative procedure compliance for animal feeding rules
headings.reviewNote: Conditions the validity of concentrated animal feeding operation rules on compliance with administrative rulemaking standards under section 536.024.

headings.title: Administration by clean water commission under chapter 644
headings.reviewNote: Assigns administrative authority over concentrated animal feeding operation statutes to the Missouri Clean Water Commission under chapter 644.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 640.755 requiring section 536.024 rulemaking compliance and clean water commission administration under chapter 644.
